title: Combating Harms of Generative AI in CS1 with Code Review Interviews and a Flipped Classroom
description:
arXiv:2605.21374v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Background and Context: Large Language Models (LLMs) are more accessible and accurate than ever before, raising significant concerns for computing educators. One major concern is students using LLMs to bypass the effort needed to understand concepts and metacognitive strategies essential for success in computer science.
